name: Mintlify Open Graph social card by mintlify.com
description: A 1200×630 brand card built on a near-black canvas with a single centered lockup: a green gradient leaf mark beside a white lowercase geometric wordmark. Depth comes from faint oversized circle outlines and diagonal strokes sitting a few percent above the background, forming an abstract line grid that never competes with the wordmark. The restraint is the point — no headline, URL or tagline, just one confident focal point with generous empty space on all sides.
